title: SelfConditionedDenoisingAtoms: code for self-conditioned denoising
description: Code for the paper Self-Conditioned Denoising for Atomistic Representation Learning. It contains the model implementations, dataset loaders, training and evaluation scripts, and configuration files. Pre-trained model weights are hosted at https://huggingface.co/Ty-Perez.
